providers.label: Spatial Studio procedural context
providers.capability: Naturalistic materials, trees, atmosphere, roofs, roads and lighting from the existing scene graph
limitations: Visual treatment only; it does not add or promote spatial evidence.
Vegetation species, façade materials and roof appearance are contextual design language unless separately sourced.

providers.label: Norrköping oblique aerial imagery 2016–2025
providers.capability: Downloadable local visual reference for roofs, vegetation, roads and neighbourhood character
limitations: Must be captured with date, coverage, licence and immutable receipt before evidence promotion.
Image interpretation remains separate from surveyed geometry.

providers.label: Norrköping live municipal aerial history
providers.capability: Exact-point live WMS reference for municipal layer titles 2008, 2010, 2017 and 2025; mounted without persisting or tracing provider pixels
limitations: The displayed years are official WMS layer titles, not independently verified capture dates.
Underlying imagery origin and layer-specific publication/reuse terms remain unresolved; the panel is a local live reference, not a published derivative.
Orthophoto does not establish legal boundary, surveyed terrain, access, building geometry or entitlement.

providers.label: Norrköping municipal 3D city model
providers.capability: Terrain, draped orthophoto and contextual building models
limitations: Exact Svärtinge coverage, level of detail, date, licence and delivery format remain unverified.
Model heights must retain municipal source metadata and cannot be treated as survey set-out without acceptance.

providers.label: Norrköping property-boundary DWG extract
limitations: The municipality states that displayed boundaries have no legal effect and may be spatially misleading.
Rights and joint facilities may be incomplete; legal boundary gate remains open.

providers.label: Lantmäteriet Buildings · Norrköping 0581
providers.capability: Exact official municipal building package identified in the vector STAC catalogue; GeoPackage asset updated 2026-08-14
limitations: The protected 14.1 MB asset returned HTTP 401 without approved Geotorget access; no footprint bytes or local clip are present.
Building heights, roof forms, façades and use may not be invented from the footprint product.

providers.label: Lantmäteriet Property Division · Norrköping 0581
providers.capability: Exact official municipal property-division package identified in the vector STAC catalogue; GeoPackage asset updated 2026-08-15
limitations: The protected 44.4 MB asset returned HTTP 401 without approved Geotorget access; the SVÄRTINGE 54:28 feature is not yet acquired.
Map geometry alone cannot close the legal-boundary gate without feature identity, cadastral acts and acceptance.

providers.label: Trafikverket NVDB Vägtrafiknät
providers.capability: Current official road-network source for a source-bound Säterdalsvägen centreline and road attributes
limitations: Metadata is public, but the exact registered-account road extract has not been acquired.
Road-network geometry cannot establish road ownership, legal access, driveway permission, construction access or an exact carriageway width.

providers.label: Mapbox Standard Satellite and Terrain-DEM
providers.capability: Live satellite, terrain, 3D buildings, lighting and shadows behind the Product Twin overlay
limitations: Requires a runtime-restricted public token and Mapbox attribution.
Tiles remain live visual context; no tracing or derivative commercial vector dataset without appropriate licence.

providers.label: Google Street View
limitations: Must remain a live, attributed Google Maps surface with required privacy and terms treatment.
Imagery cannot be prefetched, stored or used to extract geometry.

providers.label: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles
providers.capability: Live photorealistic neighbourhood background with custom concept overlay
limitations: Requires API access, billing, visible dynamic attribution and compliance with EEA terms.
Custom geometry may be overlaid but cannot be traced or derived from Google tiles; offline storage is prohibited.

providers.label: Lantmäteriet Terrain Model grid 1+
providers.capability: Exact 1 m item 650_55 identified; public provenance metadata resolves the plot-area source to airborne laser scanning dated 2020-11-20
limitations: The protected raster still returns HTTP 401 without approved download access, so no terrain value or mesh has been derived.
The current prototype retains LOCAL_RELATIVE_UNCALIBRATED terrain until the raster is acquired and passes coverage, nodata, hash and derivation QA.

providers.label: Norrköping municipal laser terrain model
providers.capability: Municipal laser data or a 1 × 1 m ground grid in LAS, DWG or GeoTIFF; the 2026 tariff reports 5 cm vertical accuracy for covered areas
limitations: Exact SVÄRTINGE 54:28 coverage, scan date, CRS, datum, licence and quoted delivery must be confirmed by the municipality.
The published minimum fee is SEK 500; no order has been placed and no coverage claim is made.
Even accepted municipal terrain would remain separate from a property-specific boundary/topographic survey.
